proposedContributions.change: Define typed preview/apply request/result/error schemas, LegacyViewMapping/MigrationReceipt and a pure strict v1 inventory/mapping builder against accepted BaseDefinition types. Input keeps exact raw payload/source SHA256 and explicitly resolved namespace; preview reports filter/sort/group/column/formula mappings and diagnostics without side effects. Bind apply digest to raw source hash, scope, mapped config and expected destination revision. Distinguish absent storage, valid empty array, malformed JSON, unsupported versions, and mixed supported/unsupported entries; never silently discard unknown entries or normalize away corrupt fields. Keep all original bytes exportable and block activation on unsupported/corrupt mappings. Use required eight error discriminants; actor is not a trusted request field. Proposed symbol names are design requests, not existing API claims.

Implement resumable migration journal on the accepted native authority transaction/recovery mechanism, not a second Base store. Persist original payload/hash, source key plus authenticated principal/workspace binding, mapping, operation identity/digest, destination ref/revision/hash and before/after verification receipts. Apply reauthorizes and checks source/destination conflicts, creates a personal BaseDefinition through the canonical owner, and records receipt/outbox intent recoverably. Resume/replay reuse the same destination ref; digest mismatch is conflict. Activate only following validated authoritative readback. Preserve rollback mapping and original payload; rollback may not delete newer acknowledged mutations. base.viewMigrated is personal/authorized with registered envelope and no automatic shared fanout.

Add consumer-behavior tests for exact v1 row/order/group/formula parity, malformed/future/mixed payload byte preservation, preview effect-freedom, authenticated actor/scope denial, stale-source/config conflict, idempotent replay, failed readback, crash/restart journal recovery and rollback after later writes. Preserve deterministic seeds/input hashes. Canonical runtime readback and seeded mutation proof require separate receipts, not passing mocked forwarding assertions.

Use the project's actual supported Electron runner after lead discovery. Exercise existing Notes table migration preview/diff, cancel/export, corrupt/future read-only state, commit pending versus validated activation, readback failure/retry, reload, keyboard/IME/focus and layout/theme/localization/font scenarios. Do not construct an isolated lookalike surface or invent a runner command.

risks: Permissive parse/filter/default fallback can hide future/corrupt entries and user edits can overwrite originals; preserving raw bytes is mandatory, not merely backing up normalized objects.
Workspace-only legacy key cannot establish private principal ownership; cross-user migration needs explicit authenticated binding, not current workspace inference.
Legacy field aliases tasks/openTasks/backlinks and formula labels differ from expression IDs; mechanical renaming can break filters/sort/group/columns, especially default column openTasks.

General typed comparator/filter semantics may differ from existing coercion/localeCompare and grouping order; deterministic parity needs an explicit legacy semantic mapping, not an unjustified engine rewrite.

Permission-aware backlinks may differ after policy changes; inaccessible values must not leak through preview/group/sort/export nor be silently coerced into a count. Define authorized current semantics through dependency contract.
Two required built-in IDs are normative; backlink/tag versioned IDs and migration schema field names require dependency alignment. Do not falsely claim a finalized registry exists.

Journal-only worker file cannot by itself register real server commands, package exports or ten-locale UI keys; reviewed root integration scope is a concrete prerequisite, not a reason to fabricate a completed API.

Current NotesTableView state initialization does not reload on namespace change; carrying old view state into a new storageKey risks cross-workspace writes. Fix inside approved migration integration seam.
Canonical commit/readback/activation and source cleanup must be recoverable and source-hash fenced; a late failure or concurrent source edit must not clear keys or create duplicate Base refs.
Rollback cannot erase canonical config mutations acknowledged after migration. Legacy adapter reactivation requires policy/revision validation and durable mapping.

Published RS-BASE-01 suggests CustomRecord kind/Postgres while reference design favors additive page contentKind and native authority; resolve at prerequisite/foundation contract rather than introducing a parallel store in LSX-WP-008.

Specified native-count mutation logically catches formula parity but does not inherently trigger source-clear failure; preserve all named assertions and independently demonstrate key-retention sensitivity without fabricating mutant results.

Inspected NotesViewHost differs from published baseline and may change under wave0; root blockTree/onOpenBlock changes are user-owned and must be retained. This preflight is not a revision-bound runtime proof.
